visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with blonde hair in a dark swimsuit lies prone on a white surfboard in a vast, deep blue ocean under a clear sky. She looks toward the horizon, where a surfer catches a breaking wave in the distance. The lighting is natural and bright daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up inside a boat under a red canopy. A woman with dark hair in braids, wearing a vibrant patterned rash guard, smiles broadly alongside a man wearing a red baseball cap and sunglasses. Both give a double thumbs-up gesture towards the camera. (3) The perspective shifts to a wide long shot of a small tropical island with white sand and palm trees. A sailboat is anchored in the turquoise water nearby. A woman is seen paddling a surfboard in the foreground. (4) Back on the boat, the man in the red cap speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with his hands and pointing towards the ocean. He wears a black t-shirt with a logo on the sleeve. The boat moves steadily, causing the water in the background to appear as a blur of motion.
